name: ORDER-FREE loop (bun + perm-then-insert + one-hop name-lookup co-training)
verdict: C1 (op-order-free) + C2 (partial) + C6 + C5 (training-free halting) in one model (Notes 259-4, 259-12, 263-3)

memory.name: DeltaMem
memory.read: x <- x + W_o [additive || delta heads](LN(x)); W_o = 0 at init
memory.additive_heads: 6: S <- S + phi(k) v^T (phi = elu + 1), read phi(q)^T S
memory.delta_heads: 6 gated-delta: S <- alpha S (I - beta k k^T) + beta v k^T, read S q
memory.write_from: final-layer state at the ':' of ' The answer is:' (one token per pass)

pass.count: K = 8 think passes (accuracy appears once K' >= d - 1 and holds to K' 14)
pass.input: [EOT] + problem text + 'How many <unit> does S_t have?' + ' The answer is:'
pass.cue: per-pass step cue names the step's subject S_t (the plan is given)
pass.lower_cache: blocks 0-5 computed once per distinct input and reused

decoder: a final direct-format pass reads the memory S_K (read-only) and answers; it adds one hop itself
aux: training only: per pass t <= d, '[EOT] Step t :' + the step's value, read-only on S_t (aux_step 1, reweighted)

training_lineage.what: GPT-2 small fine-tuned to answer 'How many u does X have?' from the text
+ 0-2 irrelevant op sentences per item (new names), 16k
+ hold-increment penalty (lambda 1.6, from step 500), 8k from dch
+ op sentences permuted (perm_p 0.5, then inserts) + 25% one-hop name-lookup ":" CE co-training, 8k from bun

scorecard.evidence: TEST2 d1-4 retained; NOT-DECODER / SWAP4 / LP5 pass; TEST-PERM (op sentences in any order) d4 0.982 / 0.961, LATE-PREMISE >= 0.979; name-swap: the cue name selects among computed entities (follow 1.000); content selection on insert_ho passes (Note 263-3). Not free under full all-sentence shuffle (d4 0.46 / 0.38).
trained d<=4: d6 0.971 / 0.959, d7 0.909 / 0.895 (bun 0.857 / 0.852; d6 NEAR-SEED, gain under one sigma_seed, not claimed) (Note 263-3)
K'64 / K'128 hold at d1-6 retained on of (Note 263-3; mechanism and norm control from bun, Note 259-4)
training-free r=3 answer-stability halting: C5-EXTRAP on of in both seeds (acc_halt = acc_k8 within 0.002 at d5-7; d7 0.908 / 0.893) (Note 263-3; rule from Notes 259-11 / 259-12)
per-pass value targets used; answer-only extension is rare (§255, 1/4)

Analytic accounting (Note 266-1): vs value-only text CoT, 1.2-1.6x fewer serial layers at K'=d (the ~9x holds only vs sentence CoT; at K'=8 more serial layers for d<=4) and 2.4-9.1x more FLOPs (d1-8; the prompt is recomputed every pass); the C5 stability halt decodes every pass (~2x FLOPs)
text fed back through the write is ignored (§247); untested on dch

limits: Plan given by the step cue
Op sentences may be in any order, but givens / S_0 must keep their trained placement relative to the ops (full shuffle d4 0.46 / 0.38)
Templated word programs (REG frames 0-5), values mod 11
Chain-reading distractors tested only right after the step they read
GPT-2 small only (§258 medium parked: no pass-2 write)
